summary: Teensy / Arduino pulse generator (v4 firmware, v3 fallback). Modern pulse-generator path — preferred over the legacy pulseStreamer.

fields.label: Serial port
fields.tip: Serial port, e.g. COM7 or /dev/ttyACM0. null = pulse generator disabled.

fields.label: Mock on failure
fields.tip: Fall back to the in-process mock when the port can't be opened. Set false to make a missing device a hard failure.

fields.label: Pin map
fields.tip: Optional name→channel mapping, e.g. {"laser488": 0}. Convenience for scripts.

fields.label: Mock channels
fields.tip: Channels the mock advertises when no real device is connected.
